title: On closed Ramsey numbers of small countable ordinals
summary: This paper is a contribution to the investigation of closed partition relations for pairs of countable ordinals. As our main result, we prove that \[ω^4 \cdot (n-2)+1 < R^{cl}(ω\cdot n+1,3)<ω^5\] for every integer $n \geq 3$. This result significantly improves the existing upper and lower bounds for these closed Ramsey numbers. In addition, we prove that \[ω^θ\nrightarrow_{cl} (ω^α,3)^2\] whenever $1 \leq α\leq θ<ω_1$ satisfy $θ< R(α,3)$.
